ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a skeletal transition-state structure, containing a fused/bridged aza-cage framework composed of multiple nitrogen atoms; the top nitrogen is connected to the carbon center marked with positive charge on the right, and several curved arrows and an Ar substituent at the lower right are also drawn in the figure. The problem requires ignoring arrows, so only the actual sigma-bond connection relationships are retained. Reasoning: Starting from the positively charged carbon center, write it as [CH+], and it is connected to the top nitrogen; continuing numbering according to the cage-like skeleton in the figure, the ring-closure connections of this polycyclic nitrogen-containing framework can be represented by N1CN2CN...CN(C1)C2; the specified nitrogen on the right bears a benzyl substituent, represented by N(Cc3ccccc3). Combining these fragments gives the SMILES: [CH+]N1CN2CN(Cc3ccccc3)CN(C1)C2.

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a skeletal transition-state drawing but discard the curved arrows as instructed. Trace the actual sigma-bond framework from the cationic carbon attached to the top nitrogen, then follow the fused aza-cage through the methylene and nitrogen atoms, assigning ring-closure numbers to preserve the bicyclic/polycyclic connectivity. Add the benzyl substituent on the indicated nitrogen as N(Cc3ccccc3). Combining these pieces gives the SMILES [CH+]N1CN2CN(Cc3ccccc3)CN(C1)C2.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个骨架式的过渡态结构，含有多个氮原子组成的稠合/桥环 aza-cage 框架；顶部氮连接到右侧带正电标记的碳中心，图中还画有几条弯箭头以及右下方的 Ar 取代基。题目要求忽略箭头，因此只保留实际的 sigma 键连接关系。推理：从带正电的碳中心开始，将其写作 [CH+]，它连接到顶部氮；按图中笼状骨架继续编号，可用 N1CN2CN...CN(C1)C2 表示该多环含氮框架的闭环连接；右侧指定氮上带有苄基取代基，用 N(Cc3ccccc3) 表示。合并这些片段得到 SMILES：[CH+]N1CN2CN(Cc3ccccc3)CN(C1)C2。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the line-angle structure: a cationic CH group/CH2+ fragment attached to the top nitrogen, a fused saturated polyaza cage containing three additional nitrogens, and a benzyl/phenyl substituent labeled Ar on the central nitrogen-containing side chain. Curved arrows and electron-pair/dashed interaction marks are explicitly ignored; only atom labels and drawn bonds define connectivity.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question instruction that the task is to choose/write the SMILES for the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use SMILES conventions for charged atoms and ring closures: represent the carbocation as [CH+], aliphatic nitrogens as N with numeric ring labels, saturated methylene links as C, and the phenyl group as c3ccccc3 attached through a benzyl carbon Cc3ccccc3.
